newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee gains against forward, spot dollar.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee gains against forward, spot dollar.

text.p: * Indian rupee gains in late morning trade on Wednesday after opening up against the forward dollar, dealers say.
* October dollars open at 1.23/1.26 rupees compared to the previous close of 1.29/1.31 rupees, other maturities show similar downtrend, dealers say.
* October dollars latest quotes at 1.22/1.25 rupees.
* Low overnight money market rates and absence of Reserve Bank of India (RBI) buying push down premiums, dealers say.
* "There is no paying interest (payment of premium against purchase of forward dollars)," said a dealer.
* The spot rupee gains mildly to 35.85/86 in late morning from 35.86/87 opening on sluggish dollar demand, dealers say.
